name: VPN
author: moonmouse11
description: VPN manager: a bar widget, panel and window for WireGuard, AmneziaWG, OpenVPN, NetworkManager, Happ subscriptions and VLESS/Shadowsocks keys, with a kill switch and leak checks.

barWidget.description: Active VPN connection; click for the protection panel, right click for the VPN window.

schema.label: Label format
schema.description: Bar label template. Placeholders: {label} {provider} {subscription} {server} {count} {state} {exit_ip} {exit_country} {exit_flag} {rate} {down} {up} {total} {total_down} {total_up} {ping} {protocol} {interface} {sub_traffic} {sub_expire} {dns} {ipv6} {killswitch} {activity} {connecting}. Empty ones drop with their separator; f in the panel cycles presets.
